channel.title: Shawon Haque — Writing
channel.description: Long-form notes on React, TypeScript, Postgres and the web — by Shawon Haque, Full Stack Developer.

item.title: Row Level Security is the only authorisation I trust
item.description: Why NEXORA puts every access rule in Postgres instead of the React client: 17 tables, 27 policies, an is_admin() helper and a trigger that stops a user promoting themselves.

item.title: A service layer that never throws
item.description: How NEXORA's 14 service modules return a typed Result instead of throwing, so a database error becomes a value the UI must handle rather than a crash it might miss.

item.title: Animation that is safe to remove
item.description: The rule behind this site's motion: every effect is additive. The WebGL hero, smooth scrolling and scroll reveals all skip themselves on reduced motion, small screens or slow devices — and the page is complete without them.

item.title: The build is the safest place to call the network
item.description: How NEXORA collects 24 publisher feeds at build time instead of in the browser: why CORS forced the decision, and how one bad feed can never break the deploy.
